notes: Verdicts by rule: ten rules are clean in all six runs. The pipeline rule is violated in run-ddcxh (line 94), run-fuhmx (line 82) and run-nkzjn (line 78), each by the same two-step pipeline on one line, and clean in run-fkkyc, run-sqmvf and run-utxgk. Deciding sentence, SKILL.md: "A pipeline never sits on one line, however short". A nested call in place of the pipeline is clean rather than not exercised, as 2026-10-31 held opus-1 line 83. One-line pipelines are graded only under the pipeline rule and not again under One expression per line, as 2026-10-31-check held them.

Closest call, One expression per line, and tabular clauses: run-fuhmx lines 126-127 and run-nkzjn lines 133-134 keep a case on one line per clause, where the first row returns a finished value and the second continues the recursion. Held clean. Each row is one pattern and one expression, so "A line reads in one pass when it holds a selection and the one expression that selection produces." passes it, and the table paragraph is not needed; 2026-10-31-check held compact case clauses this way. The shape is the value_end/3 Instead-of under the `->` rule, which is not one of the eleven rules here, so it is not graded. Direct precedent: 2026-10-31-b order-report baseline-sonnet-1 and 2026-10-31 order-report baseline-opus-1 have this shape and were graded violated on the `->` rule and clean on this rule. If the `->` rule were graded, both runs would be violated on it. run-ddcxh lines 115-116 are the clean mapping with one fallback row (`:error -> nil`) that the standard held clean.
